description: Enterprise customer relationship management (CRM) platform providing sales, service, marketing, and AI agent orchestration.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code, client credentials flows, and JWT-based bearer tokens via Connected Apps or External Client Apps.
credential_notes: Any developer can sign up for a free Salesforce Developer Edition account online to obtain sandbox/API credentials.
api_notes: Comprehensive public API coverage including REST API, SOAP API, Bulk API, Metadata API, and Connect REST API for full CRM objects and data operations.
mcp_notes: Salesforce publishes official developer tools and MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations such as Metadata Grounding MCP and Headless Toolkit support for AI clients.
rationale: Salesforce provides public REST/SOAP/GraphQL APIs, official MCP support, and self-serve free Developer Edition accounts for immediate agent toolkit development.

evidence.note: Documentation on remote access and authentication via connected apps and OAuth 2.0.
Offers free Developer Edition signup for building enterprise apps and accessing the platform.
Overview of Salesforce REST API for creating, manipulating, and searching data.
Developer portal details official MCP servers like Metadata Grounding MCP and Headless Toolkit.
